In 2012, Legislative redistricting put Ross's home in the 34th district and she chose to seek re-election there after Grier Martin , who was forced into the same district as her, announced he wouldn't seek re-election. When Ross retired in June 2013, Martin was appointed to replace her. Yvonne Lewis Holley represents a different version of the 38th district (unlike the version Ross represnted from 2003-2013) See NC General assembly "redistrcting" tab Lewis-Dollar-Dockham redistricting plan.
Ross is projected to win the 2nd district following redistricting and early returns.
